item.title: Kyung Hee Cyber University Hosts Special Lecture ‘A Physicist’s Method of Questioning’ Featuring Professor Kim Sang-wook (경희사이버대학교, 김상욱 교수 초청 ‘물리학자의 질문법’ 명사특강 개최)
item.description:
Kyung Hee Cyber University will hold a special lecture and admissions information session on Saturday, July 4, at 2:00 PM on the first floor of the Neoreunessance Hall (Neonuri Hall) at Kyung Hee University’s Seoul Campus, featuring Professor Kim Sang-wook from the Department of Physics at Kyung Hee University’s Seoul Campus. (경희사이버대학교는 오는 7월 4일(토) 오후 2시 경희대학교 서울캠퍼스 네오르네상스관 1층 네오누리관에서 경희대 서울캠퍼스 물리학과 김상욱 교수를 초청해 명사특강 및 입학설명회를 개최한다.)

This event is designed for prospective students and current students considering admission to Kyung Hee Cyber University, as well as members of the public interested in the changes of future society and the era of artificial intelligence (AI). Following the lecture, attendees can directly explore the university’s curriculum and learning environment through major-specific career counseling and one-on-one admissions counseling. (이번 행사는 경희사이버대학교 진학을 고려하는 예비 입학생과 재학생, 그리고 미래 사회와 인공지능(AI) 시대의 변화에 관심 있는 일반인을 대상으로 마련됐다. 특강 참석자는 특강에 이어서 학과별 진로상담과 1:1 입학상담을 통해 대학의 교육과정과 학습 환경을 직접 확인할 수 있다.)

Meet Professor Kim Sang-wook, a leading science communicator in South Korea (대한민국 대표 과학 커뮤니케이터, 김상욱 교수를 만나다)

Professor Kim Sang-wook, the speaker for this special lecture, is a physicist specializing in quantum science and information physics, and is widely known as a leading science communicator in South Korea. (이번 특강의 연사인 김상욱 교수는 양자과학과 정보물리학을 연구하는 물리학자이자 대한민국을 대표하는 과학 커뮤니케이터로 널리 알려져 있다.)

After earning his Bachelor’s, Master’s, and Doctoral degrees in physics from KAIST, he conducted research at overseas institutions such as the Max Planck Institute in Germany and the University of Tokyo in Japan. He currently serves as a professor in the Department of Physics at Kyung Hee University. (KAIST에서 물리학 학사·석사·박사 학위를 취득한 그는 독일 막스플랑크연구소, 일본 도쿄대학교 등 해외 연구기관에서 연구 활동을 수행했으며, 현재 경희대학교 물리학과 교수로 재직하고 있다.)

In particular, Professor Kim has conveyed science in an accessible yet profound manner through numerous publications, including *Vibration and Resonance*, *Kim Sang-wook’s Science Study*, *Kim Sang-wook’s Quantum Study*, and *Heaven, Wind, Stars, and Humans*. Through broadcasts and lectures, he introduces science not as mere knowledge but as a tool for thinking to understand the world, earning widespread resonance across generations. (특히 김 교수는 『떨림과 울림』, 『김상욱의 과학 공부』, 『김상욱의 양자 공부』, 『하늘과 바람과 별과 인간』 등 다수의 저서를 통해 과학을 쉽고 깊이 있게 전달해 왔다. 또한 방송과 강연을 통해 과학을 단순한 지식이 아닌 세상을 이해하는 사고의 도구로 소개하며 폭넓은 세대의 공감을 얻고 있다.)

His lectures, which translate complex quantum mechanics and modern science into everyday language, have garnered significant acclaim not only from science majors but also from learners in the humanities, social sciences, and arts. He is regarded as an intellectual who offers insights into the questions humans should ask amidst technological advancement. (복잡한 양자역학과 현대 과학을 일상의 언어로 풀어내는 그의 강연은 과학 전공자는 물론 인문·사회·예술 분야 학습자들에게도 큰 호응을 얻고 있으며, 기술의 발전 속에서 인간이 어떤 질문을 던져야 하는지에 대한 통찰을 제시하는 지식인으로 평가받고 있다.)

‘A Physicist’s Method of Questioning’: A Time to Learn the Power of Thought (‘물리학자의 질문법’ 생각의 힘을 배우는 시간)

The theme of this special lecture is ‘A Physicist’s Method of Questioning.’ In an era where AI and digital transformation are driving societal changes, the ability to ask the right questions is becoming as important as the ability to find correct answers. During this lecture, Professor Kim will discuss how scientific thinking influences the way we approach problems and what questions we should hold onto as we navigate an uncertain age. (이번 특강의 주제는 ‘물리학자의 질문법’이다. AI와 디지털 전환이 사회 전반의 변화를 이끄는 시대에는 정답을 찾는 능력만큼이나 올바른 질문을 던지는 능력이 중요해지고 있다. 김 교수는 이번 강연에서 과학적 사고가 문제를 바라보는 방식에 어떤 영향을 미치는지, 그리고 불확실한 시대를 살아가는 우리가 어떤 질문을 품어야 하는지에 대해 이야기할 예정이다.)

Participants are expected to go beyond simply learning scientific knowledge and experience insights into reading the times of change, expanding their thinking, and reflecting on their own lives and career paths. (참가자들은 단순히 과학 지식을 배우는 것을 넘어 변화의 시대를 읽는 통찰과 사고의 확장, 그리고 스스로의 삶과 진로를 성찰하는 시간을 경험할 수 있을 것으로 기대된다.)

From the Special Lecture to One-on-One Career and Admissions Counseling in One Place (명사특강부터 1:1 진로·입학상담까지 한자리에서)

The lecture will run from 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM, followed by an admissions information session and one-on-one admissions counseling from 3:30 PM to 4:30 PM. The admissions counseling will offer guidance on career planning for interested majors, as well as information on admission procedures, scholarship benefits, and the online learning environment. Attendees of the lecture can participate, and those interested solely in the admissions counseling can also join separately. (특강은 오후 2시부터 3시 30분까지 진행되며, 이후 오후 3시 30분부터 4시 30분까지 입학설명회와 1:1 입학상담이 이어진다. 입학상담에서는 관심 학과에 대한 진로 설계는 물론, 입학 절차와 장학 혜택, 온라인 학습 환경 등에 대한 안내가 제공된다. 특강 참석자뿐 아니라 입학상담만 별도로 참여하는 것도 가능하다.)

Lee Jeong-min, Dean of Admissions and Student Affairs, stated, “This special lecture will be a meaningful opportunity, going beyond a simple talk, to gain the power of thought and insight needed to navigate future society. We encourage anyone interested in Kyung Hee Cyber University’s education and career planning to participate.” (이정민 입학·학생처장은 “이번 명사특강은 단순한 강연을 넘어 미래 사회를 살아가는 데 필요한 사고의 힘과 통찰을 얻을 수 있는 뜻깊은 시간이 될 것”이라며 “경희사이버대학교의 교육과 진로 설계에 관심 있는 분들의 많은 참여를 바란다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, this event is free and open to anyone through prior registration. As seating is limited, individual notifications will be sent to participants after the registration deadline. For more details about the event, please visit the admissions website (go.khcu.ac.kr) or contact the admissions team at (02-3299-8765). (한편 이번 행사는 사전 신청을 통해 누구나 무료로 참여할 수 있으며, 좌석이 한정되어 있어 신청 마감 후 참석 가능 인원에게 개별 안내가 진행될 예정이다. 행사에 관한 자세한 사항은 입학 홈페이지(go.khcu.ac.kr) 또는 입학팀 상담전화(02-3299-8765)를 통해 확인 가능하다.)

item.title: Prof. Kim Tae-kyung's Research Team at Kyung Hee University Identifies Cause of Blue OLED Degradation (경희대 김태경 교수 연구팀, 청색 OLED 수명 저하 원인 규명)
item.description:
A research team led by Professor Kim Tae-kyung from the Department of Chemical Engineering at Kyung Hee University (President Kim Jin-sang) has identified the cause of degradation in blue phosphorescent OLEDs, a key challenge for next-generation displays, and proposed an integrated analysis framework to diagnose and predict it. The findings were published online in *Advanced Functional Materials* (IF=19.9), a globally renowned journal in materials science. (경희대학교(총장 김진상) 화학공학과 김태경 교수 연구팀이 차세대 디스플레이 핵심 과제인 청색 인광 OLED의 수명 저하 원인을 규명하고, 이를 진단·예측할 수 있는 통합 분석 프레임워크를 제안했다. 연구 결과는 소재 분야 세계적 권위지 『Advanced Functional Materials(IF=19.9)』에 온라인 게재됐다.)

OLED displays construct images using three colors: red (R), green (G), and blue (B). While high-efficiency and long-lifetime commercial technologies for red and green phosphorescent OLEDs have already matured, blue phosphorescent OLEDs remain the final hurdle to commercialization due to their short lifespan. Despite clear differences in lifespan between devices, there was a lack of analytical methodologies to explain the discrepancy between material properties and actual device performance. (OLED 디스플레이는 적색(R)·녹색(G)·청색(B) 세 가지 색으로 화면을 구성한다. 적색과 녹색은 이미 고효율·장수명 상용화 기술이 성숙했으나, 청색 인광 OLED는 짧은 수명으로 인해 상용화의 마지막 걸림돌로 남아 있었다. 소자마다 수명 차이가 뚜렷이 존재했음에도 소재 특성과 실제 소자 성능 사이의 차이를 설명할 분석 방법론이 부재한 상황이었다.)

To bridge this gap, Professor Kim's team combined two advanced analytical techniques. First, they integrated time-resolved photoluminescence (TrPL) analysis with ordinary differential equation models to quantitatively evaluate the 'Exciton Recycling Rate (ERR)'—the rate at which excitons in the host material are reconverted into light without being quenched. They supplemented this with magneto-electroluminescence (MEL) analysis, which applies a magnetic field to operating devices to observe exciton behavior during operation. This methodology enabled visual differentiation of molecular-level degradation mechanisms, such as triplet-polaron quenching (TPQ), where charges and excitons collide and cause losses. (김태경 교수 연구팀은 이 차이를 메우기 위해 두 가지 첨단 분석 기법을 결합했다. 먼저 시간 분해 광전도(TrPL) 분석과 상미분방정식 모델을 결합해 호스트 물질 내에서 엑시톤이 소멸하지 않고 다시 빛으로 전환되는 '엑시톤 재활용률(ERR, Exciton Recycling Rate)'을 정량 평가했다. 여기에 실제 전기를 흘린 소자에 자기장을 걸어 구동 중 엑시톤 거동을 관찰하는 자기-전기발광(MEL) 분석을 추가했다. 전하와 엑시톤이 부딪혀 손실되는 폴라론 상호작용(TPQ) 등 분자 수준의 열화 메커니즘을 가시적으로 구분하는 방법론을 제시했다.)

The results demonstrated a causal relationship: when the exciton recycling ability of the host material itself is superior to that of the exciplex state, excitons are consumed efficiently without accumulation, thereby extending device lifetime. It was confirmed that, depending on the combination of materials meeting this condition, lifetime could differ by up to five times. Professor Kim explained, "We knew there were performance differences between devices, but we lacked the microscope to see why. This study was about building that microscope." (연구 결과, 호스트 소재 자체의 엑시톤 재활용 능력이 엑시플렉스(Exciplex) 상태보다 우수할 때 엑시톤이 축적되지 않고 효율적으로 소비돼 소자 수명이 늘어난다는 인과관계가 입증됐다. 이 조건에 부합하는 소재 조합에 따라 수명이 최대 5배 차이가 발생할 수 있음을 확인했다. 김태경 교수는 “소자마다 성능 차이가 있다는 것은 알았지만, 왜 그런지 들여다볼 현미경이 없었다. 이 연구는 그 현미경을 만드는 작업이었다”고 설명했다.)

Previously, verifying device lifetime required long-term operation, but this framework enables pre-screening to diagnose lifetime characteristics and select superior materials at the material development stage. Professor Kim emphasized, "This is a methodology that can reduce repetitive trial-and-error in R&D and quickly identify promising materials." The study was supported by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy's 'Material and Component Technology Development' project and the 'Technology Development Project for OLED Commercialization Products Overcoming Limitations.' item.title: Performance Bonus Agreement Shakes the Foundation of ‘Divisional Management’… Samsung’s Choice (‘사업부제 경영’ 근간 흔드는 성과급 타결…삼성의 선택은)
item.description:
<<>> In May, a labor-management agreement was reached regarding the payment of performance bonuses at Samsung Electronics. <<> It is fortunate that the agreement stipulates that performance bonuses will not be calculated based solely on operating profit. Operating profit is the resource remaining after subtracting labor costs and material costs from revenue. Net profit is what remains after deducting the company's financial costs and taxes from this. The current corporate law principle involves calculating distributable profit based on net profit, deciding dividends at the general shareholders' meeting, and determining mid-to-long-term investment amounts. If a fixed percentage of operating profit is allocated as performance bonuses, the company could face a situation where it cannot pay interest expenses or taxes owed to the state, and distributable profit could disappear, affecting mid-to-long-term investment or dividends. <<> The lawsuit filed by a shareholder representative regarding the breach of fiduciary duty by directors is likely to be dismissed under the business judgment rule, given that there were urgent management circumstances that could have severely impacted the global semiconductor supply chain, and the agreement itself includes provisions that are not directly linked to operating profit (12% of 'management performance agreed upon by labor and management'). However, there is a high probability that opinions will be raised suggesting that it would have been better if management had anticipated this controversy at the March shareholders' meeting, proactively proposed a plan, and sought understanding, and that in the future, methods for seeking shareholder understanding should be devised. <<> Now, the next issue arises. We are faced with a company-level question of whether Samsung Electronics can maintain its divisional management system, and a fundamental question of what challenges this performance bonus agreement poses for the Korean economy. <<> Internal Question: Cracks in the Divisional Management System and Limits of Strategic Workforce Allocation <<> This performance bonus agreement fundamentally shakes the foundation of the divisional management system that Samsung Electronics has long adhered to. This is because the short-term performance-based principle of "granting performance rewards to profitable divisions but not to loss-making divisions" neutralizes the advantages of the diversified portfolio that Samsung Electronics holds as a comprehensive electronics company. Unlike SK Hynix, which has a single business division structure, Samsung Electronics is composed of a combination of heterogeneous industries, such as the Device Solutions (DS) division and the finished product (DX) division. Due to the nature of the semiconductor business, which involves extreme economic volatility and requires astronomical upfront investment, the home appliance and smartphone (DX) divisions, which require relatively less capital expenditure and generate stable cash flow, have faithfully served as a buffer for the entire company. <<> In fact, just three years ago, when the semiconductor division faced a historic large-scale deficit due to the limits of fine process technology and a demand slump, it was the retained earnings from the profitable finished product division that served as the source of R&D funds and sustained the business. This demonstrates that cross-subsidization between divisions and the function of the internal capital market were operating organically. <<> The extreme disparity in performance bonuses—paying 600 million won to the Memory business division within the semiconductor sector, 120 million won to the loss-making Foundry business division, etc., and 6 million won worth of company stock (with certain restrictions on when it can be sold) to the loss-making finished product division—could cause fatal organizational distortion under a divisional system characterized by portfolio investment. Three years ago, when the entire Device Solutions division struggled due to delays in HBM3 development, Samsung Electronics executed a strategic personnel relocation, flexibly reallocating idle workforce from the Memory division to the Foundry and System LSI divisions, which had high growth potential. However, if the current performance bonus system becomes entrenched, employees will experience annual salary differences of hundreds of millions of won depending on the coincidental business cycle of their division, leading to strong resistance against any future strategic inter-divisional transfers. This creates irreparable inequality among peers who joined at the same time, demonstrate similar capabilities, or are even tasked with overcoming more challenging advanced fine-circuit technologies, completely destroying the greatest advantage of the divisional system: its flexibility. <<> The temporary reason Samsung Electronics abandoned the struggling HBM3 was that, in the management environment before the current GPU market formed, the R&D-focused HBM division only saw expanding losses while DRAM was booming. <<> The successful market re-entry of HBM recently achieved is not solely the proprietary achievement of the Memory division. It is because close in-house collaboration between the advanced design technology of the System LSI division, the core post-process verification and package development (TSP), and the advanced manufacturing engineering of the Foundry division made crucial contributions to building the customer-customized HBM (cHBM) and 3D stacked HBM (zHBM) roadmaps. However, if engineers who contributed to this collaboration are severely discriminated against because their current division is loss-making, expecting future technological synergy through in-house cooperation becomes difficult. <<> External Question: Lack of Vision in Governance and Contrast with Global Compensation Philosophy <<> This performance bonus agreement shakes the foundation of Samsung Electronics' divisional management. Even before this, regarding Samsung Electronics' active push into the foundry business, there were proposals to split Samsung Electronics into foundry, memory, home appliance, etc., to resolve the conflict of interest where products manufactured by Samsung Foundry for competitors and their know-how could be transferred to Samsung Electronics. <<> Whose responsibility is it to decide on this issue? Fundamentally, it is the task of the board of directors, entrusted by shareholders, and the executive directors (management) appointed by the board. In our context, it is also a task for the controlling shareholder who influences the board. However, regarding discussions that negate the company's management system, Samsung Electronics' management, and even the board of directors, did not engage in discussion. The company representative, entrusted by the board, merely repeated the short-term principle of "cannot give performance bonuses to loss-making divisions," neglecting the labor-management conflict. The company failed to adequately coordinate a compelling vision of how the company creates performance and distributes it among members and shareholders at venues like the general shareholders' meeting. <<> In contrast, consider NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, who holds only 3.5% of the company's shares, and his demonstration of business and investment direction and performance forecasts during his visit to Korea. Or TSMC's chairman, who stated regarding Samsung Electronics' bonus agreement, "TSMC does not differentially compensate based on the temporary revenue scale of a specific division; even development departments or infrastructure support departments that are not generating financial profit are all organic and important members supporting the company's long-term technology roadmap." These are excellent examples of how to fulfill a director's duty of loyalty to shareholders. <<> National Industrial Challenge: Taiwan-style Extreme Division of Labor or the Preservation of a Comprehensive Manufacturing Nation? <<> The potential split of Samsung Electronics, aligned with the performance bonus agreement, transcends the individual company level and is directly linked to the industrial competitiveness and security strategy of the entire South Korean economy. During the global AI transition, the reason countries worldwide are courting Korean manufacturing is due to its outstanding manufacturing capabilities in the era of Physical AI. Amid the US-China security conflict, South Korea is evaluated as a stronghold with unrivaled precision engineering capabilities and as one of the world's top five manufacturing powerhouses, generating about 27% of its GDP from the manufacturing sector. <<> From this perspective, it is noteworthy that the cHBM and zHBM concepts mentioned during Samsung Electronics' process of overcoming its HBM business failure played a significant role. It shows the importance of reflecting experience found in the value chain of related industries for the competitiveness of advanced manufacturing. If a management approach centered on a single product had been taken, additional costs would have been incurred to gain insights from partner companies. This becomes a crucial factor for management in deciding whether to focus on core strengths through company division or maintain the divisional system. <<> This provides the fundamental reason why South Korea's national industrial strategy should not uncritically follow the Taiwanese model of division of labor. Taiwan has established a horizontal and perfect division of labor system with TSMC at its apex, but this has the structural limitation of extreme concentration in highly precise contract processing (foundry) at the bottom of the global IT value chain. In contrast, South Korea is an unrivaled 'comprehensive manufacturing nation,' possessing strong in-house design and manufacturing bases across the entire manufacturing value chain—not just semiconductors and displays, but also mobility, shipbuilding, precision chemicals, home appliances, automobiles, and ships. Consequently, the governance and compensation methods of its leading large corporation, Samsung Electronics, become the benchmark that determines the competitive strategy of the entire domestic manufacturing ecosystem. <<> Conclusion: Building Open Governance Based on Win-Win Funds and Consensus <<> In the era of the great AI transition, to prevent the collapse of the manufacturing ecosystem, shared trust is essential so that various sectors connected by the value chain can mutually react and cooperate without delay. If contribution evaluations for specific fields are biased solely by the narrow yardstick of short-term operating profit, monopolized by one-time bonus feasts for only members of large corporations, then the ecosystem of small and medium-sized subcontractors and root partner companies, which serve as the peripheral nerves of the value chain, will rapidly wither. The tacit knowledge of skilled workers remaining on the shop floors of these root industries will ultimately disappear. This is a dangerous path leading to the erosion of the very appeal of Korean manufacturing. <<> To address this, the need for a system to establish and allocate a 'win-win fund' for the manufacturing ecosystem has been raised. However, the legal basis to support this has not yet been established. The Samsung Electronics performance bonus agreement not only raises the question of whether the internal divisional management system can be sustained but also poses the problem of whether South Korea can maintain and further develop its status as a comprehensive manufacturing nation, and furthermore, how to sustain and develop the ecosystem needed for this. Stakeholders have been tasked with achieving consensus through an open attitude. <<> Lee Yong-woo, former member of the Democratic Party of Korea ()

item.title: Korean Stock Market Misses MSCI Developed Market Index Inclusion… Government: "Will Steadily Pursue Market Reforms" (한국 증시, MSCI 선진국지수 편입 불발…정부 “시장개혁 꾸준히 추진”)
item.description:
The government stated regarding the failure of the Korean stock market to be included in the Morgan Stanley Capital International (MSCI) Developed Market Index that "if foreign exchange and capital market reforms are steadily pursued, inclusion is expected to occur naturally." (정부가 한국 증시의 모건스탠리캐피털인터내셔널(MSCI) 선진국 지수 편입 불발에 대해 “외환·자본시장 개혁을 꾸준히 추진하면 자연스레 편입될 수 있을 것으로 예상한다”고 했다.)

The Ministry of Economy and Finance and the Financial Services Commission issued a statement on the 24th in response to MSCI's 2026 annual market classification results released on the 23rd (local time), which did not place the Korean stock market on the watch list for developed market index inclusion. (재정경제부와 금융위원회는 23일(현지시각) 엠에스시아이의 2026년 연례 시장 분류 결과에서 한국 증시가 선진국 지수 관찰대상국(워치리스트)에 포함되지 않은 것과 관련, 24일 입장문을 내고 이같이 밝혔다.)

The two ministries said, "MSCI is aware of the Korean government's efforts and achievements in advancing foreign exchange and capital markets," but added, "However, since some tasks are still undergoing institutional improvements, and for completed tasks, it will take more time for the market to feel their effects, we understand that Korea was not included in the watch list this year." (양 부처는 “그간 한국 정부의 외환·자본시장 선진화 노력과 성과에 대해 엠에스시아이도 인지하고 있다”면서도 “일부 과제의 경우 제도개선이 아직 진행 중이고, 완료과제의 경우에도 그 효과를 시장에서 체감하기까지 시간이 더 필요하기 때문에, 올해에는 한국이 관찰대상국에 편입되지 않은 것으로 이해하고 있다”고 했다.)

They further stated, "If we steadily pursue foreign exchange and capital market reforms according to our own needs and schedule, we expect that Korea will naturally be included in the MSCI Developed Market Index," and added, "We will promptly activate regular communication channels with major overseas investors to monitor the actual implementation of improvement tasks and reflect on-site feedback." (그러면서 “우리 스스로의 필요와 일정에 따라 외환·자본시장 개혁을 꾸준히 추진해 나간다면, 엠에스시아이 선진지수에도 자연스럽게 편입될 수 있을 것으로 예상한다”며 “해외 주요 투자자와의 정례 소통채널을 신속히 가동해 개선과제의 실제 활용상황을 점검하고 현장 피드백을 반영해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

The MSCI index is a reference used by global investors when making investment decisions. If the Korean stock market is included in the MSCI Developed Market Index, funds from global index-tracking funds would automatically flow into the country. To achieve this, the government has taken measures such as allowing foreign financial institutions to directly participate in the domestic foreign exchange market and extending the foreign exchange market closing time to 2 a.m. (엠에스시아이 지수는 전세계 투자자들이 투자를 결정할 때 참고하는 지수로, 한국 증시가 엠에스시아이의 선진국 지수에 포함되면 이를 추종하는 글로벌 펀드 자금이 자동으로 국내에 유입된다. 정부는 이를 위해 외국 금융기관의 국내 외환시장 직접 참여를 허용하고 외환시장 마감 시간을 새벽 2시로 연장하는 등의 조처를 해왔다.)

However, MSCI did not include the Korean stock market in the developed market index, citing that "the exchange of the Korean won in offshore foreign exchange markets remains limited." MSCI explained, "It acknowledges the measures announced by Korean market authorities, but investors have responded that the fundamental issues have not been fully resolved." (그러나 엠에스시아이는 ‘역외 외환시장에서 원화의 환전이 여전히 제한적’이라는 점 등을 들어 한국 증시를 선진국 지수에 올리지 않았다. 엠에스시아이는 “한국 시장 당국이 발표한 조치들을 인정한다”면서도 “그러나 투자자들은 근본적인 문제들이 완전히 해소되지 않았다는 반응을 보였다”고 설명했다.)

Reporter Shin Min-jung shin@hani.co.kr (신민정 기자 shin@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Despite massive current account surplus, exchange rate soars... Is the culprit the National Pension Service? (막대한 경상수지 흑자에도 환율 고공행진…범인은 국민연금?)
item.description:
As of June 19, 2026, the won-dollar exchange rate stands at 1,523 won per dollar, based on the Bank of Korea's benchmark rate. At the beginning of the year, the won's exchange rate was 1,435 won per dollar, but it has been steadily rising since. Typically, a sharp rise in the exchange rate indicates a dollar shortage, but this year's semiconductor-led export boom has resulted in a record current account surplus, making the recent won weakness difficult to understand. According to the Bank of Korea, from January to April of this year, the current account surplus surged to approximately $102.7 billion due to a sharp increase in semiconductor exports, yet the exchange rate has exceeded the 1,500-won level, similar to levels seen during the global financial crisis. Even after May, the current account surplus continued to grow, but the exchange rate spiked to 1,562 won in overnight trading on June 6, and recorded 1,547 won on June 9 based on the benchmark rate. How can we explain this recent rise in the exchange rate? <<>  Overseas Stock Investment and a Net External Creditor Nation <<> First, it should be noted that changes in exchange rates are influenced by many complex factors, making them very difficult to predict. Numerous factors affect the won's exchange rate, including the interest rate differential between South Korea and the U.S., liquidity growth rates, economic growth rates, fluctuations in the yen, investor expectations about exchange rate changes, and foreign exchange supply and demand. At the end of last year, some argued that the won's exchange rate had risen because Korea's broad money (M2) growth rate was higher than that of the U.S. In response, the Bank of Korea rebutted, stating that the international standard M2 growth rate was not high and that Korea's inflation rate was lower than that of the U.S. Former Bank of Korea Governor Lee Chang-yong also pointed out that the increase in individual stock investments in the U.S., such as by "Seohak Ants," had fueled the exchange rate rise. <<> An interesting point is that, as the chart below shows, since 2023, both the current account surplus and the real exchange rate have simultaneously been on the rise. A report published by the Bank of Korea in April points out that this phenomenon relates to structural changes in Korea's external sector. According to the report, after Korea transitioned to a "net external asset nation" in 2014—where assets held abroad exceeded debts—the composition of external assets shifted rapidly from reserve assets (central bank foreign exchange reserves) to private sector assets like overseas stocks. In the past, a significant portion of the current account surplus led to an increase in reserve assets, but since the mid-2010s, capital has flowed out as overseas securities investments by residents. Consequently, until 2015, an expanding current account surplus led to a decline in the real exchange rate, but afterward, the real exchange rate consistently rose despite the current account surplus. Especially since the second quarter of 2023, the current account surplus has expanded sharply, but the real exchange rate has risen even faster. Now, like other advanced economies, Korea is experiencing increased private-sector overseas asset management, making Koreans' overseas investments an important factor in the exchange rate, while the adjustment mechanism between the current account and the exchange rate has weakened. <<> In fact, in 2025, Koreans' overseas securities investments amounted to approximately $140.3 billion, more than double the $67 billion in 2024. The investment income balance based on overseas investments has also recorded a surplus since 2011 and its share within the current account balance is growing. Since the mid-2000s, Korea has shown a trend similar to that of Japan in the past, with overseas investment returns exceeding domestic investment returns, leading to an expanding share of overseas investments and increasing importance of their income. Meanwhile, according to a report published by the Bank of Korea in June, a rise in overseas investment of about 3% above the average level leads to an approximately 0.7% increase in the dollar exchange rate due to foreign exchange demand. The government has recognized this problem and implemented a policy exempting capital gains tax for long-term investments in domestic stocks when selling overseas stocks, but the effect has been minimal. Of course, an increase in investment income such as dividends and interest from abroad puts downward pressure on the dollar exchange rate, but if that income is reinvested overseas, the effect is weakened. The Bank of Korea points out that to fundamentally lower upward pressure on the exchange rate, domestic productivity and investment returns must be increased to reduce the incentive for expanding overseas investments. Ultimately, achieving structural exchange rate stability has limitations if relying solely on foreign exchange market responses; it requires expanding the foundation for repatriating investment income and enhancing domestic growth potential. <<>  DRam Dollars and Foreign Investors <<> However, this year's won exchange rate rise appears excessive. Considering that the current account surplus is at an all-time high and residents' overseas stock investments have hardly increased since February, this is not easy to explain. A Financial Times article on May 28 described this phenomenon as a puzzle. Since the beginning of the year, the Korean won has fallen about 4% against the dollar, a larger decline than other Asian countries. <<> The article pointed to two factors that have significantly influenced recent foreign exchange supply and demand. The first is the reality that Korean companies, which have achieved massive export performance in semiconductors and other sectors, are not bringing the dollars they earned into the country to convert to won. Major domestic export companies, such as those in semiconductors and automobiles, already have an overwhelming share of overseas sales and a high proportion of overseas production. Additionally, they operate using dollars for facility investments and material procurement, so they often spend the dollars earned from exports overseas, keeping them within the company rather than exchanging them in the domestic spot foreign exchange market. A prominent overseas researcher likened the dollar holdings of Korean semiconductor companies to the petrodollars of oil-producing countries, coining the term "DRam dollars." Furthermore, Korean companies' foreign currency deposits to hedge against exchange rate fluctuations have also increased significantly recently. The dollar deposit balance at the five major commercial banks stood at approximately $54.4 billion on June 11, a sharp increase from about $46.2 billion at the end of March. On June 11, the government held a meeting with major export companies such as Samsung Electronics and Hyundai Motor Group to discuss ways to convert export proceeds and repatriate overseas reserve funds. <<> The second factor, which has recently received attention domestically, is foreign investors' sale of Korean stocks and the subsequent outflow of funds overseas. As the table below shows, the Bank of Korea announced that foreign investors net sold up to $77.8 billion in stock investment funds from the beginning of this year through May, including $31.8 billion in May alone. The KOSPI index has roughly doubled from the beginning of the year to June 19, and during this process, foreigners sold over 110 trillion won worth of domestic stocks, with these funds flowing out of the country. As commonly discussed, this is due to foreign investors' rebalancing and profit-taking sales. For example, foreign institutional investors, such as pension funds, hold a certain proportion of Korean stocks in their overall assets based on indices like the MSCI (Morgan Stanley Capital International) index. However, as the value of Korean stocks has risen significantly recently, this proportion has exceeded the target, prompting them to sell Korean stocks to adjust the ratio. <<>  Controversy Over the National Pension Service's Rebalancing <<> In particular, claims have been raised that this rebalancing by foreign investors was accelerated by changes in the National Pension Service's (NPS) investment strategy. According to a Bloomberg report on June 12, Barclays, a British investment bank, argued that the NPS's deferral of portfolio adjustments boosted KOSPI returns but also increased volatility. The NPS's failure to rebalance put greater upward pressure on stock prices and facilitated foreign investors' rebalancing. Indeed, the proportion of domestic stocks in the NPS's assets rose due to the surge in stock prices, reaching about 21% at the end of March, 27.2% on May 26, and approximately 30% on June 19. Consequently, at the Fund Management Committee meeting on May 28, the NPS raised the target proportion for domestic stocks from the previous 14.9% to 20.8%, and increased the strategic asset allocation tolerance range from 3 percentage points to 6 percentage points. Given the potential adverse impact of the NPS's stock sales on the stock market, it exceptionally raised the target proportion and tolerance range. Additionally, in January, considering the high volatility in the domestic stock market, it decided to defer rebalancing until the end of June when the strategic asset allocation tolerance range was breached. Nevertheless, at the end of June, the NPS's domestic stock proportion exceeded the upper limit of 28.8% (including the tactical asset allocation tolerance range), making rebalancing through domestic stock sales unavoidable from July. <<> According to the Barclays report, the NPS's domestic stock return in the first quarter of this year was very high at about 22%, but if it had rebalanced according to the original target proportion, it would have sold approximately 130 trillion won, leading to a smaller rise in stock prices and a return of about 11%. In that case, foreign investors' rebalancing and net overseas outflow of funds would have been smaller, reducing upward pressure on the exchange rate. However, the government rebutted these claims, arguing that the causal relationship is weak and that various factors, including domestic and international macroeconomic conditions, influence the exchange rate. Furthermore, even if the NPS had rebalanced its domestic stocks, if the proceeds from those sales were invested overseas, it could have similarly exerted upward pressure on the exchange rate. However, given that the NPS recently raised its FX hedging limit to 15% and extended the $65 billion foreign exchange swap deal with the Bank of Korea, such pressure might have been somewhat limited. Above all, if the NPS had sold domestic stocks and purchased more government bonds according to the original target proportion, it could have alleviated upward pressure on the exchange rate and reduced the burden of rising market interest rates. <<> In any case, it is true that suspicions are being raised that the NPS's deviation from its original principles to increase its domestic stock holdings was a backdrop to the recent exchange rate rise, possibly linked to political considerations to boost stock prices. Of course, changes in the NPS's investment strategy aimed at improving returns and supporting capital market development for future generations are understandable, but it would be desirable for the government and the NPS to provide clear explanations for these criticisms. The criticism that the NPS played a role in amplifying, rather than stabilizing, financial market instability should be taken seriously. <<> Many analysts predict that the won's exchange rate is too high relative to current fundamentals, and with the Bank of Korea likely to raise interest rates, the won-dollar exchange rate will gradually decline. However, the reality of a high exchange rate exceeding 1,500 won per dollar becoming a kind of new normal is causing difficulties for many citizens. While a high exchange rate benefits large export companies, it raises import prices, increasing inflation and negatively affecting real income, thereby stagnating domestic demand. Considering concerns that a high exchange rate could further deepen economic polarization in Korea, now is the time for in-depth discussion and policy responses to prevent structural won weakness. <<> Kang-kook Lee, Professor, Faculty of Economics, Ritsumeikan University <<> <Lee Kang-kook's Economic Horizon: Beyond a Divided World Series> <<> ① President Trump and the K-shaped economy... Tariff burden on bottom 10% of U.S. households three times that of top 10% <<> ② If the Korean economy wants to avoid widening 'K-shaped' disparities <<> ③ 'National Dividend' floated by Office Director Kim Yong-beom... Beyond controversy to debate <<> ④ China's manufacturing dominance 'China Shock 2.0' threatens global economy (2026년 6월19일 현재 원화의 달러 대비 환율은 한국은행 매매기준율 자료 기준으로 1달러당 1523원이다. 연초 원화의 환율은 1달러당 1435원이었는데 이후 계속 높아지고 있다. 보통 환율의 급등은 달러가 부족함을 의미하는데, 올해 반도체산업 주도로 역대급으로 수출이 증가해 경상수지 흑자가 커졌기 때문에 최근의 원화 약세는 이해하기 어렵다. 한국은행에 따르면 올해 1월에서 4월까지 반도체 수출 급증으로 경상수지 흑자가 약 1027억 달러로 급등했지만 환율은 글로벌 금융위기 수준 때와 비슷한 1500원대를 넘어섰다. 5월 이후에도 경상수지가 계속 증가했지만, 6월6일 야간거래에서는 1562원까지 급등했고, 매매기준율 기준으로 6월9일에는 1547원을 기록했다. 과연 최근의 이러한 환율 상승은 어떻게 설명할 수 있을까?)

item.title: Kospi Soars Over 4% in Early Trading After Plunge… Buying in Samsung and SK Hynix (폭락 딛고 코스피 장중 4%대 급등…삼전·닉스 매수세)
item.description:
The Kospi, which plunged nearly 10% the previous day, surged over 4% in early trading on the 24th. (전날 10% 가까이 폭락한 코스피가 24일 장 초반 4%대 급등했다.)

As of 9:53 a.m., the Kospi was trading at 8550.28, up 4.22% from the previous day. It opened at 8356.79, up 1.86%, and quickly expanded its gains to over 4% in early trading. (이날 코스피는 오전 9시53분 기준 전날보다 4.22% 오른 8550.28을 나타내고 있다. 코스피는 1.86% 오른 8356.79에 출발해 장 초반 4%대로 급격히 상승 폭을 넓히고 있다.)

The Kospi had fallen 9.99% at the previous day's close, triggering a sell-side circuit breaker and a sidecar during trading hours. (코스피는 전날 종가 기준 9.99% 폭락하며 장중 매도 사이드카와 서킷브레이커가 발동한 바 있다.)

Despite the failure of the Morgan Stanley Capital International (MSCI) to include Korea in its developed market index, a wave of buying appears to have poured in, focused on semiconductor large-cap stocks that plunged the previous day. At the same time, Samsung Electronics was trading at 336,500 won, up 8.55% from the previous day, and SK Hynix was trading at 2,681,000 won, up 4.93%. (한국 증시의 모건스탠리캐피털인터내셔널(MSCI) 선진국 지수 편입 불발에도, 전날 폭락한 반도체 대형주를 중심으로 매수세가 대거 유입된 결과로 보인다. 같은 시각 삼성전자는 전날 대비 8.55% 오른 33만6500원, 에스케이(SK)하이닉스는 4.93% 오른 268만1000원에 거래되고 있다.)

Gayoon Kim, Reporter gayoon@hani.co.kr (김가윤 기자 gayoon@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "What Kind of Society Will Emerge Is a Political Choice... Social Safety Nets Needed for AI Transition" (“어떤 사회 될지는 정치적 선택…AI 전환에 안전망 있어야”)
item.description:
Carl Benedikt Frey, a professor at the University of Oxford in the UK, is a world-renowned economist who has led the "future jobs debate" by analyzing the impact of automation on the labor market for over a decade. During his keynote speech titled "How to Avoid the Technology Trap: Choices for a Good Society in the AI Transition Era" at the 5th People and Digital Forum held at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Jung-gu, Seoul on the 24th, Professor Frey emphasized the importance of the "transition period." He argued that since significant time is needed for the benefits of technological change to reach ordinary workers, managing this "transition period" well through robust social safety nets determines the future of work. (칼 베네딕트 프레이 영국 옥스퍼드대 교수는 10여년 전부터 자동화가 노동시장에 미치는 영향을 분석하며 ‘미래 일자리 논쟁’을 이끌어온 세계적 경제학자다. 24일 서울 중구 대한상공회의소에서 열린 제5회 사람과디지털포럼에서 ‘기술의 함정 어떻게 피할 것인가: AI 전환기, 좋은 사회를 위한 선택’을 주제로 기조연설을 한 프레이 교수는 ‘전환기’의 중요성을 강조했다. 기술변화의 혜택이 평범한 노동자에게 닿기까지는 상당한 시간이 걸리기 때문에 든든한 사회안전망을 통해 ‘전환의 시간’을 잘 관리하는 것이 일의 미래를 결정한다는 것이다.)

He warned of the technology trap, where if the benefits of technology are biased toward a minority, it could spark widespread public resistance and ultimately become an obstacle to innovation. Economist John Maynard Keynes was optimistic that technological progress would cause temporary unemployment but would eventually solve economic problems and free humanity from labor. However, looking at history after the Industrial Revolution, it took decades for the benefits of technology to reach ordinary workers. Labor productivity surged, yet a paradoxical phenomenon emerged where wages for lower-income groups actually declined. Professor Frey diagnosed: "The benefits of new technologies are not evenly distributed to everyone from the start, and if the transition is not managed properly, resistance to technological change, like the Luddites, emerges. Even long-term gains may not materialize." (그는 기술의 이익이 소수에게 편중될 경우 광범위한 대중의 저항을 불러와 결국엔 혁신의 장애물로 작용하는 테크놀로지의 함정을 경고했다. 경제학자 존 메이너드 케인즈는 기술 발전이 일시적 실업을 유발하지만 장기적으로는 경제 문제를 해결하고 인류를 노동으로부터 해방시킬 것이라고 낙관했다. 하지만 산업혁명 이후 역사를 보면, 기술의 혜택이 평범한 노동자에게 돌아오기까지 수십 년이 걸렸다. 노동 생산성은 크게 증가했지만, 하위 소득층의 임금은 오히려 줄어드는 역설적 현상이 발생했다. 그는 “신기술의 혜택은 처음부터 모두에게 고르게 분배되지 않으며, 전환을 제대로 관리하지 못하면, 러다이트처럼 기술 변화에 대한 저항이 생긴다. 장기적 이득마저 실현되지 못할 수 있다”며 프레이 교수의 진단이다.)

The computer revolution of the late 20th century was similar. In developed countries, including the United States, the introduction of new technologies led to productivity improvements, but workers' wages did not increase proportionally. The benefits of automation were concentrated on capitalists and high-skilled workers. (20세기 후반 컴퓨터 혁명도 비슷하다. 미국을 비롯한 선진국에서 신기술 도입은 생산성 향상으로 이어졌지만 막상 노동자들의 임금은 그만큼 오르지 않았다. 자동화에 따른 이익은 자본가와 고숙련 노동자에게 집중됐다.)

He believes that workers' lives change depending on which technology humans choose. Looking at history after the Industrial Revolution, he notes: "When adopting 'replacement technologies' that operate by replacing existing workers with machines, workers' suffering increases. Conversely, when choosing 'complementary technologies' that enhance workers' capabilities, boosting both productivity and wages, workers' lives improve." (그는 인간이 어떤 기술을 선택하느냐에 따라 노동자의 삶도 달라진다고 본다. 산업혁명 이후의 역사를 보면 “기존 노동자를 기계로 교체하는 방향으로 작동하는 ‘대체 기술’을 채택할 경우엔 노동자의 고통이 커지고, 반대로 노동자의 역량을 강화해 생산성과 임금을 함께 높이는 ‘보완 기술’을 택했을 때는 노동자의 삶이 향상되었다”고 짚는다.)

While taking a cautious stance on technology, he distanced himself from pessimism. Most of today's jobs did not exist in the 1940s. Many roles, such as IT technicians, social media managers, and data scientists, are newly created jobs. His consistent argument is that "AI can also create new industries and jobs, but for this transition process to be just, a strong social safety net must support workers so they do not suffer." Historically, countries with established poor laws for the less fortunate saw less resistance to mechanization. In regions with well-developed social safety nets, like Northern Europe, anxiety about AI is relatively lower. (기술에 대해 신중한 입장을 취하면서도 비관론과는 거리를 뒀다. 오늘날 일자리의 대부분은 1940년대엔 존재하지 않았다. 아이티(IT) 기술자, 소셜미디어 매니저, 데이터 과학자 등 상당수가 새로 창출된 일자리이다. “에이아이도 새로운 산업과 일자리를 만들어 낼 수 있지만 이 전환 과정이 정의롭게 이뤄지려면 노동자들이 고통받지 않도록 든든한 사회안전망이 뒷받침돼야 한다”는 게 그의 일관된 주장이다. 역사적으로 보면 가난한 사람들을 위한 구빈법이 정착된 나라에서 기계화에 대한 저항이 적었다. 북유럽처럼 사회안전망이 잘 갖춰진 곳에선 상대적으로 에이아이에 대한 불안도 낮다.)

However, he also stressed that social inclusiveness should not become an obstacle to creative destruction. He stated, "Without technological progress and automation, society becomes stagnant, and in the medium to long term, the situation could worsen. Therefore, we must preserve the potential for economic growth while minimizing the risk of downward pressure." He further emphasized human agency, saying, "The impact of automation on human society is not determined solely by technology itself, but by humans' political choices about what to automate and what kind of society we want." (하지만 사회적 포용성이 창조적 파괴의 방해물이 돼서는 안 된다는 점도 강조했다. 그는 “기술진보와 자동화가 없으면 정체된 사회로 이어지고, 중장기적으로 상황을 더 나쁘게 만들 수 있기에 경제성장의 잠재력은 살리면서 하향화 위험은 최대한 제한해야 한다”고 말했다. 또한 “자동화가 인간 사회에 미치는 영향은 기술 자체만으로 결정되지 않으며 무엇을 자동화할지, 어떤 사회를 원하는지에 대한 인간의 정치적 선택에 달려있다”며 인간의 주체적 의지를 역설했다.)

Han Gwi-young, Director of the People and Digital Research Institute hgy4215@hani.co.kr (한귀영 사람과디지털연구소장 hgy4215@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Swedish Miners and AI… “The Future of Work Improves Only When We Fight” [People and Digital Forum] (스웨덴 광부들과 AI…“우리가 싸울 때만 일의 미래가 나아진다” [사람과디지털포럼])
item.description:
Artificial intelligence (AI) is often likened to a massive tsunami consuming the future. However, this "metaphor" merely invites predictions about change. It keeps people as passive subjects who must deal with the aftermath. This narrative is missing "us." (에이아이(AI)는 종종 미래를 집어삼키는 거대한 쓰나미로 비유된다. 하지만 이러한 ‘은유’는 변화를 그저 예측하도록 만든다. 사람들을 사후에 수습할 수동적 대상으로 머물게 한다. 이 서사엔 정작 ‘우리’가 빠져 있다.)

In the keynote speech titled “We Are Not Machines: The Fight for the Future of Work” at the 5th People and Digital Forum, Sarah O’Connor, a labor and technology journalist and deputy editor at the UK’s Financial Times, emphasized, “The protagonists of this story are not technology, but us,” and stated, “The future of work can be better than it is now. But that won’t happen without a fight.” (제5회 사람과디지털포럼에서 ‘우리는 기계가 아니다, 일의 미래를 위한 싸움’을 주제로 기조연설을 한 세라 오코너 영국 파이낸셜타임스 노동·기술 전문기자(부편집인)는 “이 이야기의 주인공은 기술이 아니라 우리”라는 점을 강조하며, “일의 미래는 지금보다 더 나아질 수 있다. 하지만 싸우지 않고서는 그렇게 되지 않는다”고 말했다.)

Deputy Editor O’Connor argued that in an era dominated by AI determinism, the questions we need to ask are not predictions like “Can it be done?” or “Will it happen?” Instead, they are normative and ethical questions: “What should we do?” She also stressed focusing on qualitative changes in labor, rather than quantitative aspects like claims that “60% of future jobs will be exposed to automation.” (오코너 부편집인은 에이아이 결정론이 지배하는 시대, 우리가 던져야 할 질문은 ‘할 수 있는가’, ‘하게 될 것인가’와 같은 예측이 아니라고 했다. ‘무엇을 해야 하는가’라는 당위적이고 윤리적인 질문이라는 것이다. 또한 ‘미래 일자리의 60%가 자동화에 노출될 것’이라는 식의 양적 측면이 아닌 노동의 질적 변화에 주목해야 한다고 강조한다.)

Starting her lecture with a photo of old, worn boots used in the field, Deputy Editor O’Connor asserted, “Now is the time to go into the field and get our shoes dirty.” Sharing her experience interviewing translators, she pointed out, “Due to AI, translators are being reduced to post-editing workers who review machine translations.” She also introduced research showing that this issue extends beyond translators, affecting the general public consuming content due to declining translation quality. (취재 현장에서 신던 낡은 장화 사진으로 강연을 시작한 오코너 부편집인은 “지금은 현장으로 가서 신발을 더럽힐 시간”이라고 단언했다. 그는 번역가들을 인터뷰한 경험을 들려주면서 “에이아이로 인해 번역가들은 기계 번역물을 검수하는 사후 편집 노동자로 축소되고 있다”고 꼬집었다. 이는 번역가만의 문제가 아니라 번역 품질 저하로 인해 콘텐츠를 소비하는 일반 대중에게까지 영향을 미친다는 연구 결과도 소개했다.)

On the other hand, there are cases where AI had a positive impact. In a Swedish mine O’Connor personally reported on, miners vehemently opposed management’s attempt to introduce a system that tracks everyone’s location in real time. Eventually, they compromised by developing anonymizing markers, and the miners became more receptive to new initiatives, such as adopting automation technologies. (반면 에이아이가 긍정적 영향을 미친 사례도 있다. 오코너가 직접 취재한 스웨덴의 한 광산에서는 경영진이 모든 사람의 위치를 실시간으로 추적하는 시스템을 도입하려고 하자 광부들이 거세게 반발했다. 결국 익명화 표식을 개발하는 것으로 타협했고, 광부들도 자동화 기술 도입 등 새로운 시도에 우호적으로 변했다고 전했다.)

What makes the difference? Deputy Editor O’Connor emphasized that the varying outcomes of the same technology stem from humans’ active roles. She highlighted three factors: who sits at the negotiating table when tools are designed and introduced (voice), who decides how digital tools are applied in daily work (agency), and who sets the pace—workers, managers, customers, or the technology (speed). (무엇이 이 차이를 만들까? 오코너 부편집인은 같은 기술이라도 상이한 결과를 낳는 것은 인간의 주체적 역할 때문이라고 강조한다. 그가 주목한 것은 세 가지인데, 도구가 설계· 도입될 때 누가 협상 테이블에 자리하는가(발언권), 일상 업무에서 디지털 도구를 어떻게 적용할지 누가 결정하는가(주체성), 그리고 노동자·관리자·고객 혹은 기술 중 누가 속도를 정하는가(속도)가 그것이다.)

Throughout her lecture, she stressed, “The future of work can better care for the human mind and body, and more deeply satisfy the human spirit. But that won’t happen without a fight.” (그는 강연 내내 “일의 미래는 인간의 정신과 몸을 더 배려하고, 인간의 영혼을 더 만족시킬 수 있다. 하지만 싸우지 않고서는 그렇게 되지 않는다”고 강조했다.)

Kwi-young Han, Director of the People and Digital Research Institute hgy4215@hani.co.kr (한귀영 사람과디지털연구소장 hgy4215@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "More Properties, Weaker Debt Repayment Ability" (“보유 주택 많을수록 빚 갚는 능력 떨어져”)
item.description:
The Financial Stress Index (FSI), which comprehensively measures the short-term stability of South Korea's financial system, showed an increase compared to last year. This is interpreted as reflecting continued foreign selling of domestic stocks and rising debt linked to the surge in housing prices. (우리나라 금융시스템의 단기적 안정 상황을 종합적으로 보여주는 금융불안지수(FSI)가 지난해에 견줘 높아진 것으로 나타났다. 외국인의 국내 주식 매도세가 이어지고 주택 가격 상승세와 맞물린 부채 증가를 반영한 것으로 풀이된다.)

According to the 'Financial Stability Report for the First Half of 2026' released by the Bank of Korea on the 24th, the Financial Stress Index stood at 17.2 in May this year. Although lower than in March and April, it rose from 16.3 in December last year. This index is a composite indicator calculated by standardizing 20 indicators from the real economy, external sector, banking, and non-banking sectors. An index below 12 is considered 'normal,' 12 to 24 indicates 'caution,' and above 24 is assessed as a 'crisis' stage. It is based on the level during the foreign exchange crisis in January 1998 (100). ( 한국은행이 24일 내놓은 ‘2026년 상반기 금융안정보고서’를 보면, 올해 5월 중 금융불안지수는 17.2로 나타났다. 지난 3, 4월보다는 낮아졌지만, 지난해 12월 16.3보다 상승했다. 이 지수는 실물, 대외, 은행, 비은행 부문의 20개지표를 표준화해 산출한 종합지수이다. 지수가 12 미만이면 ‘정상’, 12∼24는 ‘주의’, 24이상은 ‘위기’ 단계로 평가된다. 외환위기 당시인 1998년 1월(100)을 기준으로 삼고 있다.)

The Financial Vulnerability Index (FVI), representing medium- to long-term vulnerabilities, also stood at 46.0 in the first quarter, higher than the first quarter of last year (44.3) and above the long-term average (45.7 since 2008). This is a composite indicator (1st quarter of 1997 = 100) calculated by standardizing 64 indicators related to credit, asset prices, and financial institution resilience. ( 중장기 취약성을 나타내는 금융취약성지수(FVI)도 1분기 46.0으로 지난해 1분기(44.3)보다 높게 나타났으며, 장기평균(2008년 이후 45.7)을 웃돌았다. 이는 신용, 자산가격, 금융기관 복원력 관련 64개 지표를 표준화해 산출한 종합지수(1997년 2분기=100)이다. )

At a briefing on the same day, Bank of Korea Deputy Governor Jang Jung-soo cited as sources of concern that "amid significantly heightened volatility in domestic financial and foreign exchange markets, housing prices in the Seoul metropolitan area are rising again, and asset investments using leverage (debt) are increasing." Deputy Governor Jang added that there are also concerns that the non-performing assets of vulnerable sectors could expand due to changes in financial conditions, such as rising interest rates. ( 장정수 한은 부총재보는 이날 설명회에서 “국내 금융·외환시장의 변동성이 크게 높아진 가운데, 서울 등 수도권 주택가격이 다시 상승하고 레버리지(빚)를 활용한 자산 투자가 증가하고 있다”는 점을 불안 요인으로 꼽았다. 이와 함께 금리 상승 등 금융 여건 변화에 따른 취약 부문 부실이 확대될 것이란 우려도 있다고 장 부총재보는 덧붙였다.)

In the assessment of household financial soundness, it was found that the more houses one owns, the lower the debt repayment ability. In particular, the soundness of borrowers owning three or more houses is deteriorating. As of the end of the first quarter of this year, the average delinquency rate (based on the household debt database) for multi-home owners was 0.73%, slightly higher than that of single-home owners (0.70%), and for borrowers with three or more homes, it was 1.35%. For two-home owners, this figure was 0.52%. ( 가계의 재무건전성 평가에서는 보유주택 수가 많을수록 부채 상환 능력은 떨어지는 것으로 나타났다. 특히 3주택 이상 보유 차주(채무자)의 건전성이 나빠지고 있는 것으로 조사됐다. 올해 1분기 말 기준 다주택자의 평균 연체율(가계부채 데이터베이스 기준)은 0.73%로 1주택자(0.70%)보다 소폭 높았고, 3주택 이상 차주의 경우 1.35%로 나타났다. 2주택자는 이 수치가 0.52%였다.)

The Bank of Korea stated, "Since 2021, the overall household loan delinquency rate has risen, and in particular, the soundness of borrowers with three or more homes is worsening." It assessed that "as of the end of March 2025, for multi-home households, the Debt-to-Asset (DTA) ratio stood at 35.2%, a relatively sound level, but the Debt Service Ratio (DSR) was 33.7%, higher than that of zero-home (23.1%) and single-home (28.1%) households, indicating that debt repayment capacity from an income perspective, aside from assets, is relatively vulnerable." In particular, for low-income multi-home households in the bottom 30%, the DSR was 72.9%, significantly exceeding the management threshold (40%). For high-income multi-home households in the top 30%, this ratio was 31.4%. ( 한은은 “2021년 이후 전반적인 가계대출 연체율이 높아진 가운데, 특히 3주택 이상 보유 차주의 건전성이 악화되는 추세”라고 밝혔다. 한은은 “2025년 3월 말 기준 다주택 가구의 경우 자산 대비 부채비율(DTA)은 35.2%(2025년 3월말 기준)로 양호한 수준이나 소득 대비 원리금 상환비율((DSR)은 33.7%로 무주택(23.1%) 및 1주택(28.1%) 가구에 비해 높은 것으로 나타나 자산 이외 소득 측면에서 채무상환능력은 상대적으로 취약하다”고 평가했다. 특히 하위 30% 이하 저소득 다주택 가구의 소득 대비 원리금 상환비율은 72.9%로 관리 수준(40%)을 크게 웃도는 것으로 나타났다.  소득 상위 30% 이상 고소득 다주택 가구의 이 비율은 31.4%였다.)

The Bank of Korea stated, "We will continue the coordination of monetary policy and macroprudential policy, while being mindful of the possibility that financial imbalances may gradually increase due to market sentiment in the Seoul metropolitan area housing market and rising household debt," and added, "We judge it necessary to raise the base rate at an appropriate time, considering future inflation pressures, economic trends, and financial stability risks." ( 한은은 “수도권 주택시장 기대심리와 가계부채 증가 등으로 금융블균형이 점차 증가할 가능성에 유의하면서 통화정책과 거시건전성 정책의 공조를 지속해 나갈 것”이라며 “앞으로 물가 상승 압력, 경기 흐름, 금융안정 리스크 등을 고려하여 적절한 시기에 기준금리를 인상할 필요가 있다고 판단한다”고 밝혔다.)

Senior Reporter Kim Young-bae kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kookmin University Develops and Distributes Two Proprietary Fonts, Seonggokche and Haeongche, for Its 80th Anniversary (국민대, 개교 80주년 기념 고유 서체 2종 성곡체 · 해옹체 개발 및 무료배포)
item.description:
Kookmin University (President Jeong Seung-ryeol) has developed two proprietary typefaces, Seonggokche and Haeongche, to commemorate its 80th anniversary, embodying the university’s history and future vision. (국민대학교(총장 정승렬)가 개교 80주년을 기념하여 대학의 역사와 미래 비전을 담은 고유 서체 2종 성곡체 · 해옹체를 개발했다.)

This font development project was undertaken over approximately one year to provide a consistent design identity for the 80th-anniversary commemoration events in 2026 and to distinctly embed Kookmin University’s identity in both internal and external communications. (이번 고유 서체 개발은 2026년 개교 80주년을 맞아 기념 사업 전반에 일관된 디자인 아이덴티티를 부여하고, 교내·외 커뮤니케이션에 국민대만의 정체성을 선명하게 담아내기 위해 약 1년에 걸쳐 추진됐다.)

The newly developed fonts focus on encapsulating Kookmin University’s ‘beginnings and future.’ There are two types: ‘Seonggokche,’ symbolizing the founding spirit and historical significance of Seonggok Kim Sung-kon, who revitalized Kookmin University, and ‘Haeongche,’ representing the future-oriented challenge and innovation of Kim Seok-won, Chairman of SsangYong Group and Kim Sung-kon’s eldest son. Seonggok symbolizes the university’s roots, traditions, faith in people, and the value of sincerity, while Haeong embodies Kookmin University’s unwavering challenge, innovation on the global stage, and commitment to leading the future. (새롭게 개발된 서체는 국민대의 ‘시작과 미래’를 함께 담는 데 중점을 뒀다. 국민대의 중흥을 일으킨 성곡 김성곤 선생의 창학 정신과 역사성을 상징하는 ‘성곡체’, 김성곤 선생의 장남인 김석원 쌍용그룹 회장의 미래를 향한 도전과 혁신의 의미를 담은 ‘해옹체’ 등 총 2종이다. 성곡은 대학의 뿌리와 전통, 사람에 대한 믿음과 성실의 가치를, 해옹은 글로벌 무대에서 멈추지 않는 도전과 혁신, 미래를 선도하려는 국민대의 의지를 상징한다.)

The fonts are designed to visually realize Kookmin University’s long-held vision of being ‘a university that sets the standard for higher education.' A key feature is the Variable Font system, which organically transitions between a traditional serif font with feet (stroke endings) and a modern sans-serif font without feet, marking the first such application for a Hangul font. This maximizes diverse expressive possibilities and usability within a single structure. The fonts are designed so that multiple styles can be expressed simultaneously within one font file, eliminating the need to install several fonts. (서체는 국민대가 지향해 온 ‘고등교육의 표준을 제시하는 대학’이라는 방향성을 시각적으로 구현하는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 한글 서체 최초로 부리가 있는 전통적 느낌의 세리프(Serif) 서체와 부리가 없는 현대적 감각의 산세리프(San-Serif) 서체 사이를 유기적으로 넘나드는 가변 폰트(Variable Font) 시스템을 통해 하나의 구조 안에서 다양한 표현 가능성과 사용성을 극대화한다는 점이 큰 특징이다. 여러 폰트를 설치할 필요 없이 하나의 폰트 파일에 다양한 스타일을 동시에 표현할 수 있도록 설계됐다.)

Kookmin University plans to apply the two developed fonts to various online and offline promotional materials, including the 80th-anniversary logo, banners, posters, videos, websites, and SNS content. This will enhance visual consistency across all 80th-anniversary projects and expand them into a brand asset unique to Kookmin University, shared by its members, alumni, and community. Notably, the fonts are being distributed for free under a ‘CC BY-ND (Attribution-NoDerivatives)’ license, allowing university members and the general public to broadly utilize Kookmin University’s proprietary fonts. (국민대는 개발된 2종의 서체를 개교 80주년 기념 로고, 현수막, 배너, 포스터, 영상, 웹사이트, SNS 콘텐츠 등 다양한 온·오프라인 홍보물에 적용할 예정이다. 이를 통해 개교 80주년 기념 사업 전반의 시각적 통일성을 높이고, 구성원과 동문, 지역사회가 함께 공유할 수 있는 국민대만의 브랜드 자산으로 확장해 나갈 예정이다. 특히 서체를 ‘CC BY-ND(저작자표시 및 변경금지)’ 라이선스 기반으로 무료 배포하여 대학 구성원은 물론 일반 대중도 국민대의 고유 서체를 폭넓게 활용할 수 있도록 했다.)

Professor Park Yoon-jeong from the Department of Convergence Design at Kookmin University’s Graduate School of Techno Design, who planned the font development, stated, “This font development was not merely about creating a new typeface; it was a process of organizing the 80-year history Kookmin University has walked and the future direction it will take into a single visual language.” She added, “From the perspective of the university’s spirit and history, we spent a long time reviewing materials and refining multiple drafts to naturally embed the meanings of Seonggok and Haeong within the font’s structure and impression.” She further expressed her ambition, saying, “We will develop this font, which contains the university’s history and traditions, into a cultural asset of public value.” (서체 개발을 기획한 국민대 테크노디자인전문대학원 융합디자인학과 박윤정 교수는 “이번 서체 개발은 단순히 새로운 글꼴을 만드는 작업이 아니라, 국민대가 걸어온 80년의 역사와 앞으로 나아갈 미래의 방향을 하나의 시각 언어로 정리하는 과정이었다”며 “대학의 정신과 역사라는 관점에서 성곡과 해옹이 지닌 의미를 서체의 구조와 인상 안에 자연스럽게 담아내기 위해 오랜 시간 자료를 검토하고 여러 차례 시안을 다듬었다”고 말했다. 이어서 “대학의 역사와 전통을 담은 서체를 공공적 가치를 지닌 문화 자산으로 발전시켜 나가겠다”고 포부를 밝혔다.)

Kookmin University President Jeong Seung-ryeol remarked, “The font development is one of the 10 major projects for the 80th anniversary, reflecting on Kookmin University’s journey and presenting a new direction forward.” He added, “This proprietary typeface development will contribute to communicating Kookmin University’s unique identity and vision in a differentiated way, enhancing the sense of belonging and pride among its members.” (국민대 정승렬 총장은 “서체 개발은 국민대가 걸어온 시간을 돌아보고, 앞으로 나아갈 방향을 새롭게 제시하는 개교 80주년의 10대 주요사업 중 하나”라며 “이번 고유 서체 개발은 국민대만의 정체성과 비전을 차별화된 방식으로 전달하고 구성원의 소속감과 자긍심을 높이는 데 기여할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, to celebrate its 80th anniversary, Kookmin University has declared its future vision, ‘KMU VISION 2035: EDGE,’ which embodies its determination to secure a differentiated competitive edge in the increasingly intense higher education environment. ‘EDGE’ stands for Entrepreneurship, Digital Transformation (DX), Global competency, and ESG (Sustainable Management). (한편, 국민대는 개교 80주년을 맞아 치열해지는 고등교육 환경 속에서 차별화된 경쟁우위(Edge)를 확보해 나가겠다는 의지를 담은 미래 비전 ‘KMU VISION 2035: EDGE’를 선포했다. ‘EDGE’는 Entrepreneurship(기업가정신), DX(Digital Transformation·디지털 전환), Global(글로벌 역량), ESG(지속가능경영)의 네 가지 핵심 가치를 의미한다.)

Through the development of these fonts and various other commemorative projects that capture the university’s history and future vision in connection with the 80th anniversary, Kookmin University plans to strengthen its status as a leading institution in future higher education, based on the value of ‘challenge and innovation.’ (국민대는 이번 서체 개발을 비롯하여 개교 80주년과 관련하여 대학의 역사와 미래 비전을 담은 다양한 기념사업의 추진을 통해 ‘도전과 혁신’의 가치를 바탕으로 미래 고등교육을 선도하는 대학으로서의 위상을 강화해 나갈 예정이다.)

Seonggokche and Haeongche can be downloaded and used for free from the Kookmin University website. (성곡체와 해옹체는 국민대학교 홈페이지에서 다운로드하여 무료로 사용할 수 있다.)

item.title: BOK: “Financial System Stable… Rising Home Prices and Increased Debt-Fueled Investment Are Causes for Concern” (한은 “금융시스템 안정적…집값 상승·빚투 증가는 불안 요인”)
item.description:
The Bank of Korea (BOK) said in its 'First Half Financial Stability Report' released on the 24th, "While South Korea's financial system is assessed to be largely stable, amid heightened volatility in domestic financial and foreign exchange markets, the re-expansion of housing price increases in areas like Seoul and the rise in asset investment using debt are lurking as destabilizing factors." The BOK added that it would need to raise the base rate (currently at 2.50% per annum) at an appropriate time, considering future inflation pressures, economic trends, and financial stability risks. (한국은행은 24일 ‘상반기 금융안정보고서’를 통해 “우리나라 금융시스템은 대체로 안정적인 것으로 평가된다”면서도 “국내 금융·외환시장의 변동성이 높아진 가운데, 서울 등 주택가격 상승세 재확대와 부채를 활용한 자산 투자 증가는 불안 요인으로 잠재해 있다”고 밝혔다. 한은은 앞으로 물가 상승 압력, 경기 흐름, 금융안정 리스크(위험) 등을 고려해 적절한 시기에 기준금리(연 2.50%)를 인상할 필요가 있다고 덧붙였다.)

As of the end of March, household credit stood at 1,993.1 trillion won, up 3.5% from the same period last year, and has increased significantly since May. The ratio of household debt to disposable income was 134.1% at the end of March, down from 139.7% at the end of the third quarter last year. The household loan delinquency rate (based on loans overdue by more than one month) was assessed as low at 1.00% (banks 0.40%, non-banks 2.26%) at the end of the first quarter, below the long-term average (2.36% since 2022). The proportion of vulnerable borrowers rose to 6.7% at the end of the first quarter, up from 6.4% at the end of the third quarter last year. Here, vulnerable borrowers refer to those with multiple loans from three or more financial institutions, income in the bottom 30%, and a credit score of 664 or below (equivalent to old grades 7-10). <<> Corporate loan growth rates rose slightly, centered on banks and large corporations, while the delinquency rate, after a continued decline, turned upward to record 2.43% at the end of the first quarter. The BOK assessed that corporate financial structure profitability and stability are improving. Regarding the corporate sector, the BOK added, "Considering loan shares and delinquency rates by industry, attention should be paid to the possibility of risk transfer to financial institutions in the three vulnerable sectors of construction, real estate, and wholesale/retail." <<> The volume of non-performing loans (based on substandard or below loans) at domestic banks has continued to increase since hitting a low of 9.7 trillion won at the end of September 2022, swelling to 17.7 trillion won as of the end of March this year. The BOK analyzed, "While during the previous expansion period (2015-2016), NPLs increased mainly in large corporations due to worsening debt repayment capacity and full-scale restructuring in vulnerable sectors like shipbuilding and shipping, in this current expansion period (since 2022), impairments are mainly occurring in loans to small and medium-sized enterprises." The BOK added that due to delays in the recovery of the service sector, including wholesale/retail and real estate, NPLs are occurring across various industries, and the number of affected companies is increasing significantly. <<> As of the end of the first quarter, the number of self-employed borrowers (small business owners according to the business statistics register) holding personal business loans reached 3.201 million. This number surged through the COVID-19 period, peaked at 3.259 million at the end of the third quarter of 2023, and has since been decreasing. The BOK stated that the total self-employed loans held by these individuals amounted to 1,095.5 trillion won. <<> By age structure, while the entry of young people into self-employment is decreasing, older self-employed individuals aged 60 or older increased from 1.842 million in 2015 to 2.697 million in 2025, accounting for 41.2% of all self-employed workers. As of the end of the first quarter, the average loan size for older self-employed individuals was 390 million won, surpassing that of the youth (under 30s) at 220 million won and the middle-aged (40s-50s) at 340 million won. The BOK stated, "While the income base of older self-employed individuals is weak, their debt burden is high, and their share of loans from non-bank financial institutions is gradually increasing. item.title: ‘Free savings accounts’ exploited for online fraud… Non-face-to-face openings to be limited to 3 per quarter (온라인 사기 악용된 ‘자유적금계좌’…비대면 개설 분기 3개로 제한)
item.description:
Starting within the third quarter, the number of free savings accounts a customer can open non-face-to-face per financial institution will be capped at a maximum of three per quarter. Unlike checking accounts, these accounts previously had no opening restrictions, making them vulnerable to exploitation in online second-hand transaction scams. (3분기 중으로 금융사별로 고객 1명당 비대면으로 만들 수 있는 자유적금 계좌가 분기당 최대 3개로 제한된다. 자유적금 계좌는 그동안 수시입출금식 계좌와 달리 개설 제한이 없어 온라인 중고거래 사기에 악용돼 왔다.)

The Financial Supervisory Service announced on the 24th that it will “revise regulations on free savings accounts at banks and small financial firms to protect consumers from online goods transaction fraud.” Unlike fixed installment savings, which require a set monthly deposit, free savings accounts allow customers to deposit any amount within a limit at any time, making them flexible for saving lump sums. ( 금융감독원은 24일 “은행·중소금융권의 자유적금 관련 제도를 개선해 온라인 물품거래 사기로부터 소비자를 보호하겠다”고 밝혔다. 자유적금은 정해진 금액을 매달 넣는 정기적금과 달리, 가입자가 한도 안에서 원하는 때에 원하는 금액을 납입할 수 있는 적금 상품이다.)

While these accounts are useful for consumers aiming to accumulate large funds, fraudsters have used them to create multiple accounts in a short period, enabling them to receive victim payments in installments. Checking accounts are generally limited to one across all financial institutions within 20 business days, but free savings accounts had no such restrictions. ( 소비자 입장에서는 목돈 마련에 유용하지만, 사기범에게는 여러 계좌를 짧은 기간에 만들어 피해금을 쪼개 받을 수 있는 수단이 됐다. 수시입출금식 계좌는 원칙적으로 20영업일 안에 전 금융권에서 1개만 만들 수 있지만, 자유적금 계좌는 별도 개설 제한이 없었기 때문이다.)

In practice, scammers would non-face-to-face open several free savings accounts in a short time, post fake sale ads on online second-hand trading platforms, receive payments from victims, and then immediately terminate the accounts early to withdraw the cash. ( 실제 사기범들은 비대면으로 단기간에 자유적금 계좌를 만든 뒤, 온라인 중고거래 플랫폼에 허위 판매 글을 올려 피해자들에게 입금받고 곧바로 계좌를 중도에 해지해 현금을 인출하는 방식을 썼다.)

According to cases disclosed by the FSS, one fraudster created 32 free savings accounts over three days and swindled 120 million won from 126 victims. Another scammer made 13 such accounts in two days, defrauding 80 victims of about 70 million won. Common scam items included concert and professional baseball tickets and electronic devices. ( 금감원이 공개한 사례를 보면, 한 사기범은 3일 동안 자유적금 계좌 32개를 만들어 피해자 126명에게서 1억2천만원을 가로챘다. 또 다른 사기범은 2일간 자유적금 계좌 13개를 만들어 피해자 80명에게서 7천만원 상당을 편취했다. 주요 사기 품목은 콘서트·프로야구 티켓, 전자기기 등이었다.)

To prevent these scams, the FSS will restrict non-face-to-face openings of free savings accounts to a maximum of three per person per quarter per financial institution. Accounts that have been early-terminated also count toward this limit. To open additional accounts, customers must visit a branch in person. ( 이런 사기를 막기 위해 금감원은 금융회사별로 자유적금 계좌를 분기당 1인 최대 3개까지만 비대면 개설하도록 했다. 중도해지한 계좌도 이 한도에 포함된다. 추가로 자유적금 계좌를 만들려면 영업점을 방문해야 한다.)

Termination procedures will also be tightened. To cancel a free savings account within three business days of opening, customers must visit a branch rather than doing so non-face-to-face. This measure aims to prevent scammers from early-terminating accounts and withdrawing cash before victims report the crime. Banks and small financial firms plan to implement these measures by changing their workflow and IT systems within the third quarter. ( 해지 절차도 강화된다. 자유적금 계좌를 만든 뒤 3영업일 안에 해지하려면 비대면 해지가 아니라 영업점 방문을 거쳐야 한다. 피해자가 신고하기 전에 사기범이 계좌를 중도에 해지해 현금을 빼가는 것을 막기 위한 조처다. 은행과 중소금융권은 3분기 중 업무 절차와 전산 요건을 바꿔 이런 방안을 시행할 예정이다.)

However, products with a monthly payment limit of 100,000 won or less, or those that only allow payments from the customer’s own account at the same institution—which have low risk of criminal misuse—can still be opened and terminated freely as before. ( 다만 범죄 악용 가능성이 낮은 월 납입 한도 100만원 이하 상품이나, 해당 금융회사의 본인 계좌에서만 납입할 수 있는 상품은 기존처럼 자유롭게 개설·해지할 수 있다.)

Reporter Ahn Tae-ho eco@hani.co.kr ( 안태호 기자 eco@hani.co.kr)

item.title: April's newborns hit seven-year high... largest increase on record (4월 출생아, 7년 만에 최대…증가 폭 역대 최고)
item.description:
The number of newborns in April surpassed 24,000, marking the highest figure in seven years. (4월 출생아 수가 2만4천명을 넘기며 7년 만에 최고치를 기록했다.)

According to the National Statistics Office’s “April Population Trends” released on the 24th, the (provisional) number of newborns in April was 24,521, an increase of 3,734 (18.0%) from a year earlier. The number of newborns for the month of April was the highest in seven years since 2019, and the growth rate was the highest since relevant statistics began in 1981. ( 24일 국가데이터처의 ‘4월 인구동향’을 보면, 4월 출생아 수(잠정)는 2만4521명으로 1년 전보다 3734명(18.0%) 늘었다. 4월 기준 출생아 수는 2019년 이후 7년 만에 가장 많았고, 증가율은 1981년 관련 통계 집계 가장 높았다.)

The total fertility rate (average number of children a woman is expected to have in her lifetime) for April stood at 0.93, up 0.13 from a year earlier. Following January’s 0.99, February’s 0.93, and March’s 0.93, it exceeded 0.9 for the fourth consecutive month. If this trend continues, the annual total fertility rate for this year is expected to exceed last year’s 0.80 and reach around 0.9. ( 합계출산율(여성 1명이 평생 낳을 것으로 예상되는 평균 출생아 수)도 4월 기준 0.93명으로, 1년 전보다 0.13명 증가했다. 1월 0.99명, 2월 0.93명, 3월 0.93명에 이어 넉 달 연속 0.9명을 넘겼다. 이런 추세가 이어진다면 올해 연간 합계출산율이 지난해(0.80명)를 웃돌아 0.9명 안팎에 이를 것으로 보인다.)

Fertility rates increased significantly, particularly among those in their thirties. Looking at the “fertility rate by mother’s age” (number of births per 1,000 women of that age) for April, the rate for ages 30-34 was 86.8, an increase of 12.7 from the same period last year. For ages 35-39, it was 63.4, an increase of 12.3. ( 주로 30대를 중심으로 출산율이 크게 늘었다. 4월 ‘모의 연령별 출산율’(해당 연령 여성인구 1천명당 출생아 수)을 보면, 30~34살은 86.8명으로 지난해 같은 기간보다 12.7명 늘었다. 35~39살도 63.4명으로 12.3명 증가했다. )

The number of marriages, considered a leading indicator of birth increases, also continued its upward trend. The number of marriages in April was 20,622, a 9.0% increase compared to the same month last year. This marks the 25th consecutive month of year-on-year increase. ( 출생 증가의 선행 지표로 꼽히는 혼인 건수도 증가세를 이어갔다. 4월 혼인 건수는 2만622건으로 전년 동월 대비 9.0% 증가했다. 25개월째 전년 동월 대비 증가 추세다. )

Park Hyeon-jeong, head of the Population Trends Division at the Statistics Office, said, “The influence of the large Echo Boom generation, positive changes in perceptions of marriage and childbirth, and policy effects appear to have contributed to the increase in marriages and births.” ( 박현정 데이터처 인구동향과장은 “인구가 많은 에코붐 세대의 영향, 결혼·출산에 대한 긍정적 인식 변화와 정책적 효과 등이 혼인·출산 증가에 영향을 미친 것으로 보인다”고 말했다. )

Meanwhile, the number of deaths (28,405) exceeded the number of births in April this year, resulting in a natural decrease of 3,884 people. ( 한편 올 4월 출생아 수보다 사망자 수(2만8405)가 많아 3884명이 자연 감소했다.)

Reporter Kim Yun-ju kyj@hani.co.kr ( 김윤주 기자 kyj@hani.co.kr)
